slug: 2026-06-15 Telecom Namibia signs more satellite, subsea connectivity deals with Angola firms

facts.fact: Telecom Namibia signed a pilot commercial agreement with Angola's GGPEN to use the Angosat-2 satellite platform in a real-network trial, moving on from a proof of concept, with a commercial launch to follow the pilot (reported 2026-06-15, signed the preceding Friday).

Telecom Namibia signed a master service agreement with Angola Telecom and SATCAB to integrate the Southern African Regional Submarine System (SARSSy) with the Equiano cable via Telecom Namibia's Swakopmund landing station, with Telecom Namibia as landing party and giving Angola Telecom 1 Tbps on Equiano; it builds on an MoU and commercial terms agreement signed in April 2026.

systems.tiers: Telecom Namibia (operator), targeting lodges, mines, schools, farms, businesses and rural communities

systems.platform: submarine cable interconnecting with Equiano at Swakopmund

systems.tiers: Telecom Namibia provides Angola Telecom 1 Tbps

facts.fact: Telecom Namibia, Angola Telecom and SATCAB signed the master service agreement for SARSSy on 12 June 2026, integrating it with the Equiano cable; Telecom Namibia as landing party hosts the infrastructure in Namibia and provides an initial 1.0 Tbps on Equiano, building on an April 2026 MoU and commercial terms agreement signed in Swakopmund.

systems.platform: submarine cable system integrated with Equiano
systems.tiers: operators; Angola Telecom equipment hosted in Telecom Namibia facilities

facts.fact: Telecom Namibia entered a pilot commercial agreement with Angola's GGPEN, finalised at the ANGOTIC forum in Luanda, for a real-network trial of Angosat-2 services, with full commercial launch targeted after the pilot (published 2026-06-12).

facts.fact: Namibia's ICT ministry partnered with Angola, through Telecom Namibia and GGPEN, to use the Angosat-2 satellite for remote-area connectivity; discussions began in June 2025 and a proof of concept was launched (published 2025-10-14, which is the date used).
